comment: Development pin of ken-jo/ave main, the same ref as contract/. The checker and agent-plugin component extractor were built from it with the recorded Bun recipe. A commit has no contract bundle, so publication refuses it. Once the v0.14.0 tag build publishes its signed bundle, `node tools/vendor.mjs sync --ref v0.14.0` replaces these bundles with its bytes; never edit a bundle.
